_comment: The catalog the dashboard's Tools tab renders and `bb sdk check` walks.
Adding a package here puts it on the page; it still needs a recipe in
scripts/bb's sdk_install, because every one of these installs differently
— a git clone, a tarball, sdkmanager, rustup, a vendor's shell script —
and that is the part no table can hold.
name   what bb sdk install/remove is called with.
probe  where it lands, so the page can tell installed from not:
a bare name is a directory under the SDK root, android:<pkg> is a
package directory under ANDROID_HOME, and android-image:<kind> is
a system image flavour, which may exist at several API levels.
size   the download, roughly. Replaced by a measurement once installed.

packages.name: playwright
packages.label: Playwright browsers
packages.about: Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. The image carries Playwright itself and the system libraries; these are the browser bundles bb shot and the dashboard's own tests drive.

packages.name: flutter
packages.label: Flutter
packages.about: Flutter with the bundled Dart SDK. Builds Android APKs here; the iOS half of a Flutter app still needs a Mac.

packages.name: dotnet
packages.label: .NET + MAUI
packages.about: The .NET SDK plus the maui-android workload — Android apps from C#.

packages.name: swift
packages.label: Swift
packages.about: The Swift toolchain for Linux: shared logic, server-side Swift, and compiling packages. Not an iOS SDK.

packages.name: android:emulator
packages.label: Android emulator
packages.about: The emulator binary. System images are per API level and come from ANDROID_SYSTEM_IMAGES.

packages.name: android:ndk
packages.label: Android NDK
packages.about: Native development kit, for C and C++ inside an Android app.

packages.name: android:cmake
packages.label: Android CMake
packages.about: The CMake the NDK's build system uses.

packages.name: go
packages.label: Go
packages.about: Cross-compiles from here to Windows, macOS, Linux and ARM with GOOS and GOARCH — no extra toolchain, no target to install.

packages.name: rust
packages.label: Rust
packages.about: rustup, cargo and the stable toolchain, kept in one directory. A Windows target needs a linker as well: gcc-mingw-w64 via EXTRA_APT_PACKAGES, or zig plus cargo-zigbuild.

packages.name: zig
packages.label: Zig
packages.about: A C and C++ cross-compiler as much as a language: `zig cc -target x86_64-windows-gnu` turns this box into a Windows toolchain, and it links for Rust too.

packages.name: android:playstore
packages.label: Android image: Play Store
packages.about: A system image with the Play Store, for testing anything that depends on Google Play services. Pixel-style — Samsung, Oppo and the rest ship no emulator images at all.

packages.name: android:tv
packages.label: Android image: TV
packages.about: Android TV, for a leanback-layout build.

packages.name: android:wear
packages.label: Android image: Wear OS
packages.about: Wear OS, which is what modern Galaxy and Pixel watches run.
